Title: Molecular representation learning
Description: ImageMol turns a rendered picture of a molecule into 512 features, learning from pixels rather than from a molecular graph. A ResNet18 encoder was pretrained by Zeng and colleagues on ten million unlabelled drug-like PubChem molecules through five self-supervised pretext tasks covering local substructures, global shape and image rationality, and the resulting representation transferred across 51 benchmark datasets spanning metabolism, brain penetration, toxicity and target binding. Individual dimensions are not chemically interpretable and are meant to feed downstream models.
Interpretation: 512 ImageMol features encoding molecular structure, suitable as input for downstream models.
